newsitem.title: UK: London Hong Kong stocks drift off after results.
newsitem.headline: London Hong Kong stocks drift off after results.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London drifted lower on Wednesday as a batch of blue-chip results pulled prices down in a quiet market, dealers said.
Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd, Hutchison Whampoa Ltd and CITIC Pacific Ltd all released annual results on Wednesday.

"The market is looking a bit drifty," one dealer said. "We had three big sets of figures today. All were very much in line but the shares are better offered than bid at the moment because people were anticipating very good figures anyway."
By 1450 GMT shares in Cheung Kong were trading around HK$70.225 versus $70.5 at the close in Hong Kong. Hutchison fell to HK$57.7 from $58.0 and CITIC slipped to HK$38.35 from $38.5.
The decline in the three stocks outweighed the impact of a HK$0.5 rise in HSBC Holdings shares, dealers said. The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 18.84 points at 12,757.55.
"Nobody wants to get too involved ahead of Easter and a weaker U.S. long bond is keeping people nervous," one dealer said.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng ended 56.14 points lower at 12,776.39.
